controls.title: Network access to and from the cardholder data environment is restricted.
controls.description: Network diagram, segmentation evidence

controls.title: Network security
controls.description: Network controls prevent CHD flows to unapproved AI endpoints — block at network layer; Rate limiting protecting availability of CDE-facing LLM endpoints — DoS prevention; Network controls restrict inbound traffic to CDE — rate limiting at network layer for LLM applications

controls.title: System components are configured and managed securely.
controls.description: Hardening baseline documentation

controls.title: Account data inventory
controls.description: All CHD locations documented — derived GenAI assets (embeddings, caches) included in data inventory; Synthetic payment datasets that may be re-identifiable included in CHD inventory

controls.title: Data flow documentation
controls.description: Data flow diagrams include all GenAI pipeline paths — source through embedding, retrieval, generation, logging

controls.title: SAD prohibition
controls.description: Synthetic data generated from SAD retains SAD classification — generation does not remove the prohibition; SAD must never appear in labelling tasks — labels cannot expose CVV or full magnetic stripe data; SAD (CVV, PIN) must never be in LLM training data or RAG — stored after authorisation is prohibited

controls.title: Access to displays of full PAN and ability to copy PAN is restricted.
controls.description: Memory store review, PAN protection evidence

controls.title: PAN rendering unreadable
controls.description: PANs in GenAI outputs masked — only first six/last four digits in any response; PANs extracted from multimodal content masked in all outputs — OCR-extracted PANs are CHD requiring Req 3 treatment; Synthetic PANs that pass Luhn check treated as CHD — format-preserving synthetic PANs are in PCI scope

controls.title: Primary account number (PAN) is secured wherever it is stored.
controls.description: Encryption configuration, key management records

controls.title: Protect stored account data
controls.description: All CHD in GenAI scope encrypted — training data, RAG stores, embeddings, prompt caches; All CHD extracted from multimodal inputs encrypted at rest — OCR output of a payment document is CHD; Per-user session CHD encrypted — KV cache isolation prevents cross-session PAN exposure

controls.title: PAN is protected with strong cryptography during transmission.
controls.description: TLS configuration, protocol verification

controls.title: Encryption in transit
controls.description: All GenAI data flows carrying CHD encrypted — TLS 1.2 minimum; Multimodal extraction pipelines encrypted in transit where CHD is in scope; All LLM API calls and RAG retrieval paths carrying CHD encrypted in transit — TLS 1.2 minimum

controls.title: Malicious software (malware) is prevented, or detected and addressed.
controls.description: Integrity check configuration, verification records

controls.title: Bespoke software security
controls.description: Secure code review records, findings, remediation

controls.title: Bespoke software — injection
controls.description: All injection vulnerability classes addressed in GenAI ingestion code — schema bypass and path traversal; LLM-to-SQL interfaces address injection as a known vulnerability class — query allowlisting, parameterised execution; All injection vulnerabilities addressed in LLM integration code — prompt injection as a known injection class

controls.title: Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed.
controls.description: Vulnerability scan results, patch records

controls.title: Vulnerability management
controls.description: All GenAI software components patched — CVE-2024-3584 class treated as urgent for CDE scope; Vector database CVEs patched — CVE-2024-3584 class treated as urgent for CDE-scope stores; Browser AI extensions patched and version-controlled — vulnerable extensions are Req 6.3 findings in CDE

controls.title: Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks.
controls.description: WAF configuration, protection evidence

controls.title: Public-facing application protection
controls.description: LLM-powered query interfaces in CDE scope protected — WAF or equivalent, input validation; Model extraction pattern detection as application protection — systematic API abuse detected; LLM-powered customer-facing applications protected against prompt injection — WAF or equivalent, security testing

controls.title: Secure system changes
controls.description: Change management records

controls.title: Secure system changes
controls.description: Model component updates follow change management — security testing before production

controls.title: Secure system changes
controls.description: All model promotions tested for unexpected functionality — poisoning detection as Req 6.5 testing requirement; RAG corpus updates tested for unexpected content — integrity verification before production indexing; All model promotions tested for unexpected functionality before CDE deployment — poisoning as unexpected functionality

controls.title: Access to system components and data is appropriately defined and assigned.
controls.description: Access control matrix for agent tools, privilege review records

controls.title: Restrict access
controls.description: RAG retrieval access controls — users retrieve only CHD they are authorised to access; Agent credentials scoped to minimum CDE access — least privilege, quarterly review; Context minimisation — tools receive minimum CHD-containing context required

controls.title: Access to system components and data is managed via an access control system(s).
controls.description: Periodic access review records

controls.title: Access control system
controls.description: Access control system enforces LLM tool scope — agent cannot exceed defined CDE access without explicit authorisation

controls.title: User identification and related accounts for users and administrators are strictly managed throughout an account's lifecycle.
controls.description: Account inventory, unique account evidence

controls.title: Unique IDs for access
controls.description: Each agent has a unique service identity — no shared credentials across CDE-facing agents

controls.title: Strong authentication for users and administrators is established and managed.
controls.description: Credential management policy, rotation records

controls.title: Media disposal
controls.description: Derived GenAI assets containing CHD disposed of securely — deletion verified per Req 9.4 requirements

controls.title: Audit logs are implemented to support the detection of anomalies and suspicious activity, and the forensic analysis of events.
controls.description: Audit log configuration, sample log entries

controls.title: Logging of all access
controls.description: All agent credential operations in CDE logged — issuance, use, anomalous patterns; All tool call payloads containing CHD logged — Req 10 audit trail requirement; All PAN access through multimodal pipelines logged

controls.title: Audit log review
controls.description: Automated monitoring of GenAI outputs in CDE — systematic anomalies indicating poisoning detected; Automated monitoring for GenAI pipeline health in CDE — freshness and availability metrics reviewed; Automated monitoring for extraction patterns — unusual query diversity alerted

controls.title: Failures of critical security control systems are detected, reported, and responded to promptly.
controls.description: Monitoring configuration, alert records, detection evidence

controls.title: External and internal vulnerabilities are regularly identified, prioritized, and addressed.
controls.description: Pen test report with goal hijack test cases

controls.title: Penetration testing
controls.description: Poisoning detection in CDE penetration testing programme; Path traversal and ingestion injection in CDE penetration testing scope; Multi-tenant isolation tested in CDE penetration testing — cross-session CHD access attempted

controls.title: Security policy
controls.description: PCI security policy covers GenAI processing of CHD — updated to reflect AI system deployments

controls.title: Risks to the cardholder data environment are formally identified, evaluated, and managed.
controls.description: Risk analysis for agentic AI in PCI scope

controls.title: Annual assessment
controls.description: Annual targeted risk analysis covers all GenAI systems that may process CHD

controls.title: Targeted risk analysis
controls.description: Targeted risk analysis for agent credential scope in CDE — blast radius if credentials compromised; Targeted risk analysis for ungoverned GenAI-derived assets — scope, protection, lifecycle documented; Re-identification risk in synthetic payment datasets documented in targeted risk analysis

controls.title: Programme oversight
controls.description: Executive accountability for GenAI PCI compliance — CISO or equivalent with oversight documented

controls.title: TPSP oversight
controls.description: Shadow AI discovery as part of TPSP monitoring — identify unapproved vendors receiving CHD

controls.title: Security awareness education is an ongoing activity.
controls.description: Training curriculum, completion records

controls.title: Security awareness
controls.description: PCI security awareness programme covers shadow AI risk — staff trained on prohibition; Security awareness covers PCI obligations in GenAI context — staff understand scope implications; PCI staff trained on LLM output limitations — advisory status of AI recommendations communicated

controls.title: TPSP programme
controls.description: TPSP list, written agreements, compliance confirmations

controls.title: Third-party service providers
controls.description: Shadow AI tools processing CHD are unapproved TPSPs — not in TPSP list, no written agreements; All tool and plugin providers receiving CHD in TPSP list — even if access is indirect through agent context; Browser AI extension providers with CDE access are TPSPs — add to TPSP list, initiate compliance process

controls.title: TPSP agreements
controls.description: Written agreements with tool providers acknowledging CHD security responsibility; Written agreements with labelling vendors acknowledging CHD security responsibility; Written agreements with LLM vendors — acknowledge responsibility for CHD security

controls.title: TPSP PCI DSS compliance
controls.description: Monitor TPSP PCI DSS compliance status — LLM component vendors with CHD access have compliant status verified

controls.title: Incident response
controls.description: Incident response procedure covers GenAI pipeline failures affecting payment processing
